dev.description: Runs an app's dev server, which reloads on changes

check.description: Checks each package: TypeScript with tsc, Rust with rustfmt and Clippy

test.description: Runs each package's tests: TypeScript with Vitest, Rust with cargo test

transit.description: Runs nothing. Its hash covers the files of the packages a package imports, so the tasks that depend on it miss the cache when those change

generate:client.description: Generates the API client before running tasks in packages that depend on it

format.description: Formats the Rust code; Biome formats the rest from the root, in `pnpm fix`
